passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: You should carefully consider all of the information in this document and the following risk factors before making an investment decision regarding our securities. Any of the following risks could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and the actual outcome of matters as to which forward-looking statements are made in this document. Risks Relating to Our Business General global economic and business conditions affect demand for our products. We compete in various geographic regions and product markets around the world. Among these, the most significant are global infrastructure, industrial, and commercial and residential markets. We expect to experience fluctuations in revenues and results of operations due to economic and business cycles. Important factors for our business and the businesses of our customers include the overall strength of the global economy and our customers’ confidence in the economy, industrial and governmental capital spending, the strength of infrastructure and commercial and residential markets, unemployment rates, availability of commercial financing, interest rates, inflation rates, and energy and commodity prices. Recessions, economic downturns, inflation, slowing economic growth and social and political instability in the industries and/or markets where we compete could negatively affect our revenues and financial performance in future periods, result in future restructuring charges, and adversely impact our ability to grow or sustain our business. Macroeconomic and political instability caused by global supply chain disruptions, inflation and the strength of the U.S. dollar could adversely impact our results of operations. In addition, military conflicts and their impact on economies may adversely impact our results of operations. The businesses of many of our industrial customers are to varying degrees cyclical and have experienced periodic downturns. While we attempt to minimize our exposure to economic or market fluctuations by serving a balanced mix of end markets and geographic regions, any of the above factors, individually or in the aggregate, or a significant or sustained downturn in a specific end market or geographic region could reduce demand for our products and services, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows. We compete in attractive markets with a high level of competition, which may result in pressure on our profit margins and limit our ability to maintain or increase the market share of our products. The markets for our products and services are geographically diverse and highly competitive. We compete against large and well-established national and global companies, as well as regional and local companies and lower-cost manufacturers. Competition may also result from new entrants into the markets we serve offering products and/or services that compete with ours. credit_strengths.text: Gross leverage sits below the sector median and improved markedly year over year, reflecting debt reduction alongside EBITDA growth from the Electrical Products Group acquisition. The indicative financial risk profile lands at Intermediate, with leverage in the strongest tier and meaningful headroom before the next risk-band boundary.

Operating margin exceeds the sector median even after a year-over-year decline, and revenue expanded sharply across the three-year trend. Pricing discipline and mix in the infrastructure and industrial end markets support earnings resilience through cyclical demand swings described in the risk factors.

key_risks.text: Free cash flow falls short of combined dividends and buybacks, so shareholder distributions absorb more than internally generated cash and the shortfall must be funded from balance-sheet resources. Buybacks alone consume a large share of free cash flow, leaving limited retained cushion for acquisitions or deleveraging.

The risk factors flag competition and pricing pressure from large global and lower-cost manufacturers, plus cyclical industrial demand, tariffs and currency volatility. These pressures could compress margins and cash flow precisely when the company is funding an acquisition and returning capital.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage improved year over year and remains comfortably above unity, but it trails the sector median, so debt service headroom is adequate rather than superior. Operating income covers cash interest several times over, and EBITDA coverage is stronger still, giving room to absorb rate resets on the term debt.

The maturity ladder is well spread, with only a small current portion due in the next twelve months and the largest tranches falling in later years. Liquidity is adequate: the current ratio exceeds the sector median, though it slipped year over year and cash includes restricted balances.

overall_credit_view.text: Credit quality is solid for an industrial machinery issuer: leverage below the sector median, improving coverage and a spread maturity profile. Cash flow to debt trails the sector median and weakened slightly year over year, so the Intermediate profile rests on leverage strength rather than cash-flow generation.

Our forward view is that deleveraging continues only if distributions are moderated and acquisition integration delivers; otherwise free cash flow after shareholder returns stays negative and leverage headroom narrows. We treat the risk profile as indicative, not a rating, and note cash interest paid is a proxy for interest expense.

credit_strengths.text: 總槓桿低於行業中位數，且按年顯著改善，反映減債之餘，亦受惠於電氣產品集團收購帶動的 EBITDA 增長。指示性財務風險狀況落在 Intermediate，槓桿處於最強級別，距離下一個風險區間界線仍有相當緩衝。
即使按年下跌，營業利潤率仍高於行業中位數，而收入在三年趨勢中大幅擴張。基礎設施及工業終端市場的定價紀律與產品組合，支撐盈利抵禦風險因素所述週期性需求波動的能力。

key_risks.text: 自由現金流不足以覆蓋股息與回購合計，股東分派吸納的金額超過內部產生現金，缺口須以資產負債表資源填補。單是回購已消耗大部分自由現金流，留作收購或去槓桿的緩衝有限。
風險因素指出，來自大型全球及低成本製造商的競爭與定價壓力，加上週期性工業需求、關稅及匯率波動。這些壓力可能在公司正為收購提供資金並回饋資本之際，壓縮利潤率及現金流。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率按年改善，並穩居於一以上，但仍低於行業中位數，故償債緩衝屬足夠而非優越。營業收入覆蓋現金利息數倍，EBITDA 覆蓋更強，有空間吸收定期債務的利率重設。
到期結構分佈良好，未來十二個月內到期的即期部分僅佔小額，最大批次則於較後年份到期。流動性足夠：流動比率高於行業中位數，儘管按年下滑，且現金包括受限制結餘。

overall_credit_view.text: 對於工業機械發行人而言，信貸質素穩健：槓桿低於行業中位數、覆蓋率改善，到期結構分散。現金流對債務比率低於行業中位數，並按年略為轉弱，故 Intermediate 狀況依賴槓桿實力而非現金流產生能力。
我們的前瞻觀點是，只有在分派受到節制且收購整合見效的情況下，去槓桿才會持續；否則股東回報後的自由現金流將維持負值，槓桿緩衝收窄。我們將風險狀況視為指示性而非評級，並註明已付現金利息為利息費用的替代指標。
